svg.title: ariadne, live race
svg.desc: ariadne, live replay: three micromouse planners race through the same 16 by 16 maze in the simulator, at 5x speed. v1: pivot turns: 39.5 s; v2: smooth turns: 15.98 s; v2: smooth + diagonals: 15.33 s. The best plan is 2.6 times faster than pivot turns. Opens the live race on the ariadne website.
